_comment: URL-shape regression guard. Controlled stress test, NOT a real-world false-positive estimate. See docs/url_shape_guard.md.
threshold_rationale: Proposed, review required. Evidence (reports/model_optimization/model_comparison.md, validation): production flags 1.24% of template-shaped legitimate URLs; the template-invariant candidates flag 3.07% (c1, scheme/www stripped) and 1.17-6.0% (c2/c3, host only, threshold-dependent). A 5% absolute ceiling is about 4x production's in-template rate and above c1's 3.1%, so a reasonable shape-robust retrain can pass, while the observed shortcut (85-100%) fails decisively. The 3-point gap limit catches shape dependence even when the as-is rate is low. Trade-off: a lower ceiling forces a higher decision threshold and costs recall (c3 reached 1.2% but caught only 54% of test phishing); a higher ceiling lets partial shortcuts through.

2f2e1d492ec3bc96891df3c08d3e80ff158021f6.reason: Production URL model (2026-10-28) learned the PhiUSIIL https://www.<host> template.
